newsitem.title: GERMANY: Ifo-Based 97, 98 forecasts on dlr at 1.80-1.90 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Ifo-Based 97, 98 forecasts on dlr at 1.80-1.90 dmk.

text.p: The Ifo economic research institute said on Tuesday that it had based its economic forecasts for 1997 and 1998 on the assumption that the dollar would be between 1.80 and 1.90 marks from now until the end of 1998.
"But the exchange rate is an assumption, not a forecast," Ifo president Karl Heinrich Oppenlaender told a news conference.
Ifo earlier said it expected German economic growth to reach 2.25 percent in 1997 and 2.75 percent in 1998. The dollar was trading just above 1.87 marks at 0937 GMT.
